sources.title: Marc Farag, Damian Harland and Dan Nixon — Bank capital and liquidity (Bank of England Quarterly Bulletin, 2013 Q3, pp. 201–215)
sources.use: Historical UK central-bank conceptual primer for bank balance-sheet funding, equity versus deployable cash, valuation bases and high-level ratio denominators. Original chapter ledger, definitions, calculations and exercises supply their own assumptions.
sources.verification: Opened official landing page dated 17 September 2013 and actual 15-page PDF. Read printed pp. 201–206 (balance-sheet assets/funding, loss absorption, capital/liquidity distinction, accounting and valuation box), liquidity discussion p. 207 and high-level ratio comparison p. 209. The 2013 incurred-loss timing, then-proposed accounting changes, deposit-protection limits and regulatory thresholds are deliberately excluded from current claims. No source numerical example is reproduced.
